EVAL-CT-M2-S1.title: Define Enrollment Status Schema and Contract
EVAL-CT-M2-S1.description: Define a normalized schema for clinical trial enrollment status including values such as RECRUITING, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, COMPLETED, and UNKNOWN, aligned to ClinicalTrials.gov response fields.

EVAL-CT-M2-S2.title: Implement Enrollment Status Extraction Logic
EVAL-CT-M2-S2.description: Extract enrollment status from ClinicalTrials.gov API response and map raw status values into normalized schema values defined in the contract.

EVAL-CT-M2-S3.title: Handle Missing and Ambiguous Enrollment Status
EVAL-CT-M2-S3.description: Implement fallback handling for trials with missing, null, or ambiguous enrollment status, defaulting to UNKNOWN and ensuring no pipeline failures.

EVAL-CT-M2-S4.title: Expose Enrollment Status via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-CT-M2-S4.description: Integrate normalized enrollment status into clinical trial results returned by evaluate_care_facade so downstream consumers receive structured status information.

EVAL-CT-M2-S5.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Enrollment Status
EVAL-CT-M2-S5.description: Create unit tests for status extraction and normalization logic and integration tests validating end-to-end flow from ClinicalTrials.gov API response through facade output, including edge cases.
